department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

deadline.value: The primary admission deadline is February 1 for Fall intake.
deadline.quote: The primary deadlines for admission in all program is February 1 for Fall intake and October 1 for Spring intake.

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not required for any graduate program, though it helps with assistantships.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required of any graduate program at MSState

funding.value: Admission and assistantship offers are separate decisions, and faculty select their own research assistants.
funding.quote: Admission and financial assistantships are separate decisions.

also.quote: Each faculty member selects his/her own Research Assistants (RA)

entry_route.value: Students can enter directly from a bachelor's degree or with a previous master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Direct admit with a B.S. and programs for students with a previous M.S. are both available.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.
